examples/origin_neg_fnvalue.sober:10:24: violation the shared cache policy 'Fresh' meets a handler or middleware that reaches a credential source (http.Authorization / http.Cookie / Request.head) in one route — a response that depends on Authorization / Cookie must not be stored by a shared cache — it would be served to other users (language.md 12 節「出所の依存」); use http.Private / http.NoStore for this route, or move the credential read out of it
